packet_scope_matches_plan.evidence: This existing artifact was selected only because CM-30 audit marked artifact_found=true with partial/schema-incomplete status; CM-30A1 does not expand work-order scope.

self_approval_forbidden_check.evidence: The normalized packet-quality contract rejects sub-agent self-approval; parent architect/reviewer acceptance remains required where the row needs review.

review_stale_after_mutation_check.evidence: Any file mutation after review makes the prior review stale until rechecked; this artifact is schema evidence only and does not self-approve later mutations.

completed_null_rejected_check.evidence: A packet with completed:null is rejected and cannot serve as evidence.

accepted_verdict_vocabulary_check.evidence: Accepted verdicts must be explicit review vocabulary such as pass, partial, open, fail, repair_required, continue_execution, or operator_input_required; vague done/ready wording is not sufficient.

next_bounded_action_required_check.evidence: When goal_reached=false, the packet must expose an exact next bounded action; protocol/report/commit/push checkpoints are not stop reasons when the next action is known.

evidence_packet_required_fields_check.evidence: Evidence packets must include concrete files changed, verification results, commit/push status when required, and exact next action; report/smoke/static-only evidence cannot claim full completion.

parent_review_required_check.evidence: Parent architect/reviewer coordinates and reviews; bounded sub-agent execution evidence is not self-approval.

legacy_fields.claim_scope: OR-04 asset lifecycle completion review after diagnostic held-out runner. OR-04 closes at asset lifecycle plus diagnostic held-out/ablation scope only. This does not claim headline semantic generalization, host runtime, adaptive work, or broad model quality.
